title: Stargate SG-1: Through the Gate
summary: Entertaining, source-grounded audio essays about Stargate SG-1: the original film and pilot, character, command, humor, grief and the pleasures of a galaxy made navigable. This active collection begins with two standalone full-length essays and will expand into episode close readings, ethical dilemmas, production history and an eventual ten-season retrospective.
assumed_background: The film-to-series opening essay assumes no prior Stargate viewing and spoils only the feature film and television pilot.
The character essays are accessible with basic SG-1 familiarity but include major story spoilers explicitly identified in each manuscript.
These are original critical audio essays, not episode-by-episode retellings or television scripts.
